messages:
sam: Noticed several mid-size tenants suddenly hitting v1->v2 diffs during a dry rollout. Need a quick decision: auto-fallback window 60s or 300s?

lucy: 60s is too short for transient infra blips, 300s catches more real regressions. But it delays rollback detection. My vote: 300s for full-route, 60s for canary.

diego: Also think about quota smoothing. If we fallback instantly, burst will hit v1 and could exhaust dedicated pools. Propose a graded fallback: percent->0 in steps of 25% every 30s instead of immediate 100% flip.

sam: Good point. So fallback rule = {threshold, step_percentage=25, step_interval=30s, final_cutover=0}. Document it in router schema.

ops-bot: router-bot: noted. fallback_policy schema supports step_percentage and cooldown.

lucy: Console UX: show a small timeline bar when migration active that shows percent routing over time and a big red badge if auto-fallback triggered with reason. Keep language non-alarming.

diego: Telemetry to collect: output_match (%), tokens_delta_pct, p95_latency_delta, regression_count. Also include `migration.batch_id` and `fallback.reason` in logs.

sam: Legal note: if we change routing for a tenant automatically, do we require consent in contract? @legal - quick take.

legal: Short answer: auto-fallback for safety is OK under existing TOS, but any billing-impacting automated changes need disclosure. Add console checkbox "I consent to safety rollbacks" for full-route flows and record a consent audit entry.

lucy: Nice. Also add an audit log entry for any automatic routing override: who triggered it (system), batch_id, reason, and snapshot of last 5 diffs.

diego: One more: telemetry sampling rate. For large tenants we can sample 2% for diffs, for small tenants 100% limited to 1k requests/day. Prevent metric noise.

sam: OK action items: diego -> implement graded fallback + sampling (18h), lucy -> console timeline + consent checkbox (2d), legal -> short blurb for consent copy, ops-bot -> add fallback schema to router docs. I'll assemble final RFC and ping the migration owners.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for config=migration-fallback-stepper v=2026-09-01-canary

sam: Thanks. We'll reconvene after canary metrics land.
